name: GitHub Codespaces (personal Free)
free_limit: GitHub Free personal accounts: 120 core-hours/month and 15 GB-month Codespaces storage
watch_out: Organization accounts do not receive this personal free quota. A 2-core machine consumes 2 core-hours per elapsed hour; if no payment method is on file, Codespaces usage is blocked when the free quota is exhausted instead of auto-billing. Paid overages require a payment method and budget controls.
